security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Local OpenRouter-style router for free LLM APIs
bundle.longDescription: Chat with and route between free LLM API tiers (Groq, Gemini, Mistral, Cerebras, GitHub Models, NVIDIA and more) through one local OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with rankings that recommend which model to use. All data stays on your Mac.
